root_idea.summary: The root centers on paucity and smallness: being few or little in number, quantity, degree, or extent.
root_idea.development: The numerical idea of fewness extends to smallness, short duration, comparative inferiority, limited worth, and figurative rarity or weakness. Derived forms also develop meanings of making something appear little, carrying a burden, becoming independent, and related specialized usages.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Feminine inflection of the same adjective, presented under the singular citation form قَلِيل.

senses.definition: To become few, small, scanty, or deficient in quantity or amount.
senses.usage_conditions: Applies to a thing whose quantity, supply, yield, or supporting resources become limited.

senses.definition: To make something or someone appear few or little; to cause it to be regarded as small in number or amount.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction concerns making an opposing group appear few in the observers' perception, rather than necessarily reducing its actual number.

senses.definition: To lift or carry; to bear a load that is light relative to the bearer's capacity.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usage, the subject is a cloud bearing a heavy cloud-load or rain-bearing mass, described as light in relation to its strength.

senses.definition: Less or fewer than another in amount, number, or possession.
senses.usage_conditions: One Quranic construction makes the comparison explicit in wealth and children; the form may also compare groups or amounts more generally.

senses.definition: Few or little in number, quantity, amount, or degree.
senses.usage_conditions: May qualify countable groups, uncountable quantities, actions, knowledge, possessions, and other things considered limited or small in amount.

senses.definition: A short time; briefly or for a little while.
senses.usage_conditions: A temporal use in which the omitted or understood noun is a period or duration.

senses.definition: Fewness viewed figuratively as lowliness or weakness, or as rarity and consequent distinction.
senses.usage_conditions: The figurative evaluation depends on context: being few may imply weakness or low standing, while the rarity of the few may imply special distinction or excellence.

senses.definition: Scarcely or rarely in the construction قَلِيلًا مَا.
senses.usage_conditions: قَلِيلًا مَا may be understood as a near-negative such as “scarcely,” though it may also qualify the following action as being done to a small degree; the Quranic example involving belief admits both readings.

senses.definition: Small or insignificant in worth or consequence.
senses.usage_conditions: In evaluative Quranic expressions, worldly price or enjoyment is called little by comparison with the greater value promised in the hereafter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be smaller than, or too small for, something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational construction with عَنْ, expressing insufficiency in size or capacity for the matter at hand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one's wealth, good, or beneficence to become scanty; by extension, to become poor or niggardly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes deficiency or lack of goodness, wealth, or generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disquiet or flurry someone through anger; to become agitated or tremulous from anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic and figurative Form IV use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become poor or to have little property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive use concerning reduced possessions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become diminished or reduced in quantity or size.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive or middle-reflexive use describing a quantity becoming small.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To see, judge, or deem something to be little in quantity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive perceptual use, not necessarily a claim that the object has objectively decreased.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be independent or alone, without anyone sharing or participating; to manage one's affairs by oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes absolute independence and the construction اِسْتَقَلَّ بِنَفْسِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise or raise oneself while bearing a burden; of a bird, to rise in flight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A movement construction describing elevation under a load or in flight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become affected by trembling or tremor through anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or medio-passive expression of agitation caused by anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take exclusive control of something or deal with it independently of others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction اِسْتَقَلَّ بِالشَّيْءِ denotes acting exclusively with or appropriating a matter.
A nominal usage distinct from the adjective قَلِيلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The top or highest part of a mountain or other thing; specifically the top of the head or the hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a summit, uppermost part, or raised crown-like portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A jar or large earthen vessel, especially one of a size that a person can lift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete nominal usage distinct from the meaning “summit” or “top.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Paucity, smallness, scantiness, insufficiency, or lack; sometimes absence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote want of a due amount or want of care, as in قِلَّةُ مُبَالَاةٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lacking or nearly destitute of goodness or wealth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In قَلِيلُ الخَيْرِ, the phrase can describe someone deficient in good or property; an idiomatic application is also explained as not making use of oaths at all.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Independent, self-contained, or devoted to a particular subject; a monograph or an independently standing meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a specialized writing, a monograph, or a meaning treated as independent.

cautions: In قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ, the expression permits both a near-negative reading (“you scarcely believe”) and a degree reading (“you believe little”).
The anatomical meaning reported in lane-unit:qll:21084:g1:sub3 is left unassigned because the same passage says the form is more properly derived from قلت rather than قلل.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:qll:21084:g1:sub3 reports قُلَّتَانِ as a possible form for the hollows of the two collarbones, but explicitly prefers قَلْتَانِ from the separate root قلت; root assignment is therefore uncertain.
